reviews.review: Почему куски тория похожи на яеца

God Mindustry is such a hidden gem! Pick it up if you like RTS, management, or automation games. Hybrid game between factorio-like base building gameplay and creating RTS units with said base. Currently has two(?)(at the time of writing this) entire campaigns packed full of content and plenty of custom maps and user created content to keep you going for a while. Very very good! (more people need to know about this good game goddamnit! (It's even on mobile!!) 

Warning: as with all games in the Factory/Automation genre (especially this one), I would say playing this game is the closest you can get to taking crack without actually doing so. Be careful with that free time! Also please remember to take showers from time to time.

I played this game for like 3 years for free off of the mindustry itch.io thingy, but after some very careful consideration, my cheap ahh bought the game because it is truly worth it, there is no better deal. The updates are looking so good for the game in the future, and considering it's single dev, I would 100% recommend paying the 10 bucks.

Addictiveness of this game in honestly paranormal. Probably it's because of simplistic visual design, which give a rather false sense of casuality. "Oh I can beat it easily! Just build some pumps here, wall there, a turret here, mining, some power grid all over the place.."

It's 3 a.m. You have no clue how you got there. You spent last eternity placing conveyor belts and battery racks.

Somehow you're totally fine with it.

issues.title: Banning t1 serpulo units mid-construction resets the timer when unbanned
issues.body:
### Platforms

Android

### Build

v160.7

### Issue

When you ban t1 serpulo units and a constructor is making a serpulo t1 unit, the constructor doesn't get to build the units, which is as intended.

However if you unban the t1 serpulo units, you would need to reselect a new unit to build rather than it continuing.

### Steps to reproduce

Ban and then unban t1 serpulo units while a t1 constructor is making one.

(Note: Other constructors/reconstructors/fabricators/refabricators/assemblers dont have this problem)

### Mods used

None

releases.name: v8 Build 160.7
releases.body:
- Fixed command/stance changes not working on servers
- Fixed shield break effect spam appearing when a shielded unit is hit by Parallax turrets

releases.name: v8 Build 160.6
releases.body:
- Updated app icon
- Fixed units stuttering when pathfinding towards a moving target
- Fixed client disconnect when commanding large numbers of units
- Fixed naval units getting stuck on doors in water
- Fixed a rare server physics crash
- Fixed empty fields in logic shifting parameters
- Fixed directional unloader deserialization issues with mods
- Fixed console remaining open if disabled while open
- Fixed status effects in logic not being transferred to new status system
- Fixed sandbox team core switch softlock
- Fixed healing projectiles not always targeting the unit's main target
- Fixed mod classloader deadlock
- Added support for loading data patches in mods for the sake of future compatibility (loaded from patches/ folder)
